protocol.gate_formula: z=(pre-RMSNorm post-attention residual-mean)/std; raw=z@encoder.T+bias; gate=raw if raw>theta and raw>0 else 0
protocol.precision: native BF16; full MOLT FP32 TF32 disabled
protocol.native_models: base with disabled adapter versus identical base with medical adapter enabled
protocol.input_pairing: identical saved token sequence for both models
protocol.cache_policy: Recomputable native activation cache deleted wave by wave only after per-token and per-example reconstruction metrics saved and hashed. Stress activations retained.

10.criteria_rationale: FP32 matrix products and reduction orders can differ at near-zero coordinates due to cancellation. Accept only per-token relative L2 error <= norm_rtol against an independent CPU float64 full reconstruction in both raw and standardized coordinates; zero reference vectors require exact zero error. Apply the same per-token relative L2 criterion to the complete encoder preactivation vector across all features, retaining every scalar failure and its gate-boundary margin as diagnostics. All CPU/GPU gate masks must agree exactly. Individual UV and contribution checks are required for active audited features; arbitrary inactive audit features are diagnostic only. A shared-GPU-gate CPU reference is diagnostic only and cannot override independent-reference failure.

numerical_validation_protocol_change.initial_stop: Layer 18 validation stopped after a near-zero coordinate differed by approximately 5.7e-5, exceeding the original 5e-5 elementwise absolute tolerance.
numerical_validation_protocol_change.independent_diagnostic: An independently computed full CPU float64 reconstruction gave approximately 9.1e-7 relative L2 error for the initially failing sample.
numerical_validation_protocol_change.encoder_scalar_stop: The intermediate revision stopped at one inactive encoder scalar differing by approximately 2.0e-4, while its CPU gate-boundary margin was approximately 0.080 and all CPU/GPU masks agreed. The final revision checks encoder vectors normwise and records scalar failures without using them as acceptance criteria.
numerical_validation_protocol_change.revised_acceptance: Per-token normwise relative L2 error at most 1e-5 against the independent full CPU float64 reference, in both raw and standardized coordinates; zero reference vectors require exact agreement. Encoder vectors must meet the same per-token relative L2 criterion, and every CPU/GPU gate mask must agree. Original encoder scalar and reconstruction elementwise checks remain nonblocking diagnostics.
numerical_validation_protocol_change.rerun_scope: The first wave (layers 10, 16, 18) was remeasured from saved native activations: layers 10 and 16 had previously completed, and layer 18 was partial. The same revised criteria were then applied to the remaining wave (22, 25, 29).
numerical_validation_protocol_change.unchanged: No change to model weights, saved native captures, or the FP32 reconstruction measurement formula.

interpretation_limits: Selected natural text corpus, not established as held out from Qwen or MOLT training
Frozen MOLT error under EM combines representation drift and MLP mapping changes
Distribution overlap is not equivalence or sufficient reconstruction quality
No causal claim about gate behavior or EM prevalence
Relative squared error uses uncentered output energy; it is not variance explained
